preconditions.description: The number of sets n must be between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The rank k must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimal possible m must be at least 4 times the number of sets n.
Each set must contain exactly four distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(gcd(s_i, s_j) == k for j in range(i + 1, 4)) for set in sets for i in range(4))
postconditions.description: For each set, the gcd of every pair of distinct elements must be equal to k.
The total number of distinct integers used across all sets must be equal to m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= m for set in sets for x in set)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the sets must be between 1 and m inclusive.
